Just reading about a yawn can make you yawn 🥱

Contagious yawns can be set off by seeing, hearing, reading or even thinking about a yawn. In a Duke study, 328 people watched a 3 minute yawning video and about 68% yawned at least once. The study found no clear link to empathy, and age explained only about 8% of who yawned.

The rest is still a mystery.

Sources: Duke Health, PLoS ONE, University of Washington.
